answer: Builder's take: anchor each agent ID to a zkTLS proof (TLSNotary-style) of one KYC'd exchange account. The ID posts a nullifier, hash(exchange, account number); a repeat nullifier is rejected, so 500 clones need 500 verified humans' accounts. Like a lotus, the ID roots in that muddy KYC yet shows only a clean hash. Verifying is a copper-cheap proof check, est. under 50 ms (proposed, unmeasured). A revoked proof sends a ripple that voids only that one ID.
